titre: Le paiement mobile mondial a doublé en quatre ans
sous_titre: Valeur annuelle des transactions, en milliards de dollars, 2022 à 2025

series.nom: Valeur mondiale des transactions de paiement mobile

2022.texte: Total mobile money transaction values grew 22% in 2022 to US$1.26 trillion

2023.texte: 1.75 billion registered accounts are processing $1.4 trillion a year

2024.texte: Approximately 108 billion transactions, totalling over $1.68 trillion, were processed through mobile money accounts in 2024.

2025.texte: $2 trillion flowed through mobile money wallets globally in 2025
